connection_failed_hint: Make sure the remote server has a VNC server running (e.g. TigerVNC, x11vnc) and the SSH connection details are correct.
connection_lost_detailed:
Connection lost. Possible causes:
• VNC server not running
• SSH tunnel disconnected
• Network issue
vnc_auth_failed_password_hint: VNC authentication failed. Please check your password.
password_required_desc: Enter the VNC password you set on the remote server via the vncpasswd command.
setup_guide_desc: Follow the steps to set up VNC
checking_vnc_status: Verifying VNC server status on remote host...
vnc_running_need_password: VNC server is running on port {{port}}. Enter the VNC password to connect.
vnc_running_no_password: VNC server is running on port {{port}} with no password required.
vnc_installed_not_running: VNC is installed but not running. Start it in the terminal on the left, or ask the AI Assistant for help.
vnc_not_installed: VNC server is not installed on the remote host. Use the AI Assistant below to install it.
enter_vnc_password_to_connect: Enter the VNC password, then click Connect.
connect_without_password: This VNC server requires no password — click Connect Now.
vnc_setup_ai_hint: VNC is not installed or not running. Use the AI Assistant below to install and configure it on the remote server.
windows_setup_title: Windows remote: manual VNC setup required
windows_setup_steps: Please complete the setup manually on the remote host: 1) Install TightVNC or UltraVNC; 2) Set a VNC access password; 3) Allow port 5900 through the Windows firewall; 4) After starting the VNC Server, click "Re-check" in this guide and connect with the port.
open_ai_assistant_failed: Failed to open the AI assistant. Please check that an AI model is configured.
ai_maintenance_hint: You can also ask the AI Assistant for other remote maintenance: change passwords, check port usage, explain commands, clean up disk, and more.
vnc_mode_hint: VNC Desktop: Requires a VNC server on the remote host and provides a full desktop environment. Best for complete GUI sessions.
